LlmFallback.PromptTemplate:
Extract the amount, reference, and date from the following message. Respond ONLY with JSON matching {"amount": number, "reference": string or null, "date": "yyyy-MM-dd" or null}. The reference must be exactly one of these two values: the reference copied exactly as it appears, made only of letters (A-Z, a-z) and digits (0-9), 1 to 50 characters, with no spaces, hyphens or other symbols; or null if the message has no reference, it is incomplete, or it contains any character other than letters and digits. Never return an empty string or placeholders such as "N/A", "none", "unknown" or "not visible".

Message: "{{message}}"
